title: Pre-registered: is 'it came to pass' Smith's all-purpose 'then'? (PREREG 30, JST)
label: registered
question: When Joseph Smith added 'it came to pass' to the KJV in the JST, was it event-first at the Book of Mormon's share?

headline.text: PREREG 30 (registered): 52 added formulas in JST OT narrative, 39 event-first, S = 0.75 (0.61–0.86). Verdict: R1, the habit transfers.

Without the five boundary spill-overs (Amendment 2): 47 added, 38 event-first, S = 0.81 (0.67–0.91); verdict unchanged. Shows the idiom was Smith's by 1830; whether he had it before the Book of Mormon is untested.

data.verdict: R1 HABIT TRANSFERS: H_then is a sufficient explanation of the event-first share
data.amendment2_verdict: R1 HABIT TRANSFERS: H_then is a sufficient explanation of the event-first share
